synth_small_nasdaq: synthetic nasdaq MBO dataset generated by queuetruth-testkit (no market data).

Regenerate: make fixtures (cargo run --locked --release -p queuetruth-testkit --example make_fixtures);
MANIFEST.sha256 lists every file (shasum -a 256 -c MANIFEST.sha256).

Generator: qt_testkit::generate_sessions_with(fixture_config(nasdaq), 2, Some(QueueMix::REALISTIC)): 30% of cancels and partial cancels from the front of the queue, 25% from its front half, the rest uniform, 25% of modifies queue-jumping re-quotes; seed 7; 2 instruments; 30000 events per instrument and session; tick 10000000 and base price 150000000000 at price_exp -9; up to 10 levels per side; mean order size 150; weights add 0.42, cancel 0.28, reduce 0.06, modify 0.08, sweep 0.13, snapshot clear 0, hidden print 0.02; snapshot at start false; mean event gap 1041400000 ns.
Session: time zone America/New_York, open 34200 s, close 57600 s after local midnight; data runs from 5 minutes before the open to about 15 minutes after the close.

Layout: manifest.json, instruments.parquet, data_quality.json, mbo/date=*/instrument_id=*/part-00000.parquet (qt.mbo, feed order), trades_source/... (qt.trades, the T records), truth/ (independent expectations: shadows.parquet + amends.parquet = a seeded schedule of 250 shadows per partition with abs and touch prices, latency, cancels and amends; shadow_results / shadow_fills / queue_trajectory (ahead) from qt_testkit::try_reference_shadows with the replay defaults; bbo.parquet = bbo full mode, one row per event).

Partitions (date, instrument, records, events, trade prints, hidden prints):
  2026-06-15 instrument 1: 49417 records, 30000 events, 9175 prints, 435 hidden
  2026-06-15 instrument 2: 49841 records, 30000 events, 9413 prints, 456 hidden
  2026-06-16 instrument 1: 49364 records, 30000 events, 9182 prints, 462 hidden
  2026-06-16 instrument 2: 49834 records, 30000 events, 9374 prints, 440 hidden
